title: Why did the concurrency test fail once under full-suite parallel load?
statement: What caused the single observed failure of the separate-process concurrency test during a full parallel run on 2026-08-18, and is serialisation implicated at all?
notes: Carried in a code comment and a commit message until now (#105). maxWaitMs was raised 10s -> 30s as a MITIGATION on an unconfirmed diagnosis; the failure output was never captured, so no observation distinguishes a lock timeout under load from a harness problem. Reopening condition: any recurrence. AST-0003 stays refuted until this is answered or a run of sufficient size supports a restated claim.
